levelIntro.ai-tutorial: Tap the label that matches the picture. No timer, so take a good look first.
levelIntro.ai-l1: Build the training set: labelled examples your model (the AI you're teaching) learns from. Pick the right label fast and chain a streak!
levelIntro.ai-l2: Tiles hide each picture and lift one by one. Guess early for more points; wrong guesses cost a little. Tap Reveal (limited) for one tile.
levelIntro.ai-l3: Bonus round! Drag a box that hugs the item tightly, or use the move and resize buttons. Then lock it in.
levelIntro.ai-l4: Your model has labelled each picture and says how sure it is. Flag the wrong ones. Careful: being sure isn't being right.

tutorialHint: Tap the label button that matches the picture.

fieldGuide.heading: What to look for
fieldGuide.intro: Every label has its own look. Match the shapes and colours you see.

entries.water: Blue bottles or a jerrycan with a screw cap
entries.food: Brown cardboard box or sack with a grain or tin icon
entries.medical-kit: White or red case with a red cross and a handle
entries.blanket: Stack of soft folded rectangles, striped or plain
entries.tent: Triangle shape with a door flap and pegs
entries.generator: Boxy machine on wheels with a dial and exhaust pipe
entries.flooded-road: Road with wavy blue water hiding the lane markings
entries.clear-road: Dry grey road with dashed white lane markings

question: What's in the picture?
answer: The answer is {label}. Tap it to carry on.
timeUp: Time's up! Let's see how you did.

covered.instruction: Guess as soon as you know. Earlier guesses score more points.
covered.wrongTile: Not that one. A tile lifts to help you out.
covered.allShown: Every tile's gone. Take your best guess!

box.instruction: Drag a box that hugs the item's edges, or use the buttons. Then tap Lock it in.
box.keys: Your box. Arrow keys move it; Shift plus arrows resize it.
box.miss: That box missed: {pct}% overlap. Hug the edges.
box.hint: Tighter! Each side of your box should touch the item's edge.
box.answer: The dashed outline shows the right box. Match it, then lock it in.
box.credit: These are stand-in drawings. Real AI teams train on huge collections of photos, each labelled with boxes just like yours.
box.keysVisible: On a keyboard: arrow keys move the box, Shift + arrows resize it.

audit.instruction: Check each label your model gave. Looks right? Say so. Wrong? Flag it. Trust the picture, not the %.
audit.caught: Good catch! Your model got that wrong.
audit.missed: Missed it. Real label: {label}. Your model said {predicted}.
audit.falseFlag: That label was right. Your model got this one.
audit.hint: High confidence can still be wrong. Check the picture, not the %.
audit.answer: Your model said {predicted}. The picture shows {label}.

result.heading0: Teaching machines is tricky. Have another go!

learned: You labelled {count} pictures. AI learns from labelled examples like yours, but it still makes mistakes, so humans must check it.

a11y.where: It's in the {where} of the picture.
a11y.boxReadout: Your box: {x}% from the left, {y}% from the top, {w}% wide, {h}% tall.
a11y.truthReadout: Right box: {x}% from the left, {y}% from the top, {w}% wide, {h}% tall.
